feed.title: NPR Topics: National
feed.subtitle: NPR coverage of national news, U.S. politics, elections, business, arts, culture, health and science, and technology. Subscribe to the NPR Nation RSS feed.

entry.title: This city led the way on reparations for Black people. Trump is trying to stop it
entry.summary: Evanston, Ill., became the first U.S. city to compensate Black people for historical discrimination. The Justice Department is trying to kill its program before other cities follow suit.

entry.title: Forecast says families will spend more to heat their homes this winter
entry.summary: It's probably going to cost more to heat your home this winter. Forecasters say heating bills are likely to climb faster than overall inflation, despite what's expected to be a relatively mild winter.

entry.title: Kennedy Center board says venue could close soon due to financial woes
entry.summary: NPR's A Martinez speaks with Washington Post arts and government reporter Jonathan Edwards about internal documents showing the Kennedy Center could close as soon as Tuesday.

entry.title: Amazon suspends use of 21 Air, cargo carrier whose plane careened off Miami runway
entry.summary: Amazon said it's decided to pause operations with 21 Air as the investigation into the crash continues. North Carolina-based 21 had flown packages for Amazon since 2024.

entry.title: Wisconsin congressman survives emergency plane landing, swims to safety
entry.summary: Wisconsin Congressman Tom Tiffany escaped a sinking plane and swam to shallow water after an emergency landing in a lake. Tiffany and the pilot called 911 from on top of the plane.

entry.title: A TikTok-famous masked superhero is roaming the streets of Roanoke, Virginia
entry.summary: NPRs Ayesha Rascoe talks to The Roanoke Raven, a local Virginia "superhero" who highlights the work of nonprofits at events and in social media videos.

entry.title: How a young woman was recruited to ISIS — and how she eventually escaped
entry.summary: A young Canadian mother shares her memories of being an ISIS bride, and her harrowing escape from the extremist group.

entry.title: 25 years post 9/11, a grieving sister finds peace at United 93 crash site
entry.summary: On September 11, 2001 Lori Guadagno lost her brother on flight United 93. 25 years later, the crash site is a place where she feels a sense of connection that she can't find anywhere else.

entry.title: Alien Terrorist Removal Court deports legal US resident to Afghanistan in first-ever case
entry.summary: Nazira Haji Zada, a lawful permanent resident, conceded to being an "alien terrorist." It marks the first case in the Alien Terrorist Removal Court.

entry.title: Manhattan's Trinity Church unveils new pipe organ, replacing one damaged in 9/11 attacks
entry.summary: Manhattan's Trinity Church marked the 25th anniversary of 9/11 with a concert featuring a new cathedral-sized pipe organ, replacing the hundred-year-old instrument damaged in the attacks.
